enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Command: Passive: +3 Insight bonus on Charisma based skill checks. Command armor and command shields make their owners very noticeable, imposing a -6 penalty on Hide checks.
True Seeing: Passive: You gain the benefit of the spell True Seeing.
Insightful Incite +14: +14% Insight bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage
Insightful Fortification +29%: +29% Insight bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
